subject: Quantica: compliance path, pen-test scope, and mutual action plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@quanticafin.com>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@quanticafin.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-07T15:10:00Z
Subject: Quantica: compliance path, pen-test scope, and mutual action plan

Hi Aisha / Sara —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call + proposed next steps so your team (security, legal, procurement) can align internally. I tried to capture the pain/goals we discussed and concrete asks for each owner.

Key pain/goals we heard
- Data residency & retention: need 7 years of audit-log retention for transaction events; logs must be exportable in parseable format (CSV/JSON).
- SOC 2: you need more than the SOC 2 letter — a mapping of controls to evidence artifacts and a timeline for remediation for any gaps.
- Pen test: desire a vendor-run external pen test that includes network + app layer for our integration points; Quantica requires a scoped report and remediation window.
- Contract: DPA redlines and a procurement timeline tied to a procurement PO and legal review.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan) — please confirm owners/dates
1) Redwood to share:
   - SOC 2 mapping CSV (control -> artifact + sample artifact) — attached as redwood-soc2-mapping.csv
   - Example audit-log key export and TTL options — attached audit-log-sample-keys.txt
   - Draft DPA with our suggested redlines (word doc) — attached proposed-dpa-redline.docx
   - MPA draft (high-level milestones & dates) — attached mpa-draft.xlsx
   Target: sent by EOD 2027-02-07 (today) — owner: Connor (me)

2) Quantica to share:
   - Procurement timing and PO template; legal point of contact for DPA review — action by 2027-02-10 — owner: Aisha/Sara

3) Security: agree pen-test scope & timeline
   - Proposal: vendor-led external pen test within 8 weeks of contract signature; Redwood to supply test endpoints and sample data scope.
   Request: Quantica to confirm acceptable vendors or provide required vendor checklist by 2027-02-12 — owner: Quantica security/Procurement

4) Follow-up call: technical + legal sync — propose 2027-02-11 or 2027-02-12 (30–45m)

Notes/assumptions
- For the retention ask, Redwood can support exportable audit logs (JSON/CSV) and a configurable retention policy; if Quantica needs on-prem retention we can discuss Private deployment options in a follow-up.
- SOC 2 mapping is intended to accelerate evidence requests — it is not the full attestation; we can offer an engineer walkthrough of artifacts if helpful.

If this looks right, can you confirm owners for items 2 and 3 and preferred time for the follow-up call?

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-mapping.csv, audit-log-sample-keys.txt, proposed-dpa-redline.docx, mpa-draft.xlsx
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@quanticafin.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@quanticafin.com>
Cc: procurement@quanticafin.com
Date: 2027-02-08T02:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Quantica: compliance path, pen-test scope, and mutual action plan

Connor —

Appreciate the clear recap and the artifacts you just sent. Quick confirmations from our side:

- Procurement/PO: procurement@quanticafin.com is the right inbox — we aim to route vendor agreements through procurement the week of Feb 15.
- Legal: our GC team will need to review the DPA; tentative timeline 2 business weeks from when we get the redline. Please cc legal@quanticafin.com when you share the doc.
- Pen test: Quantica requires a minimum 3rd-party vendor (no internal-only tests) and an executive summary with CVSS scoring on findings. We can provide a vendor-approved list; I will share that list by 2027-02-11.
- Retention: 7 years is the expectation for transaction-level audit logs; for PD/PI we may have different retention windows — I'll flag specifics after legal review.

Let's tentatively schedule a technical + legal sync on 2027-02-11 at 10:00 AM PT. Can you and your security/product folks join?

Thanks,
Aisha
Head of Integrations, Quantica Financial
aisha.k@quanticafin.com

Quick notes based on your points:
- DPA: we'll resend the proposed-dpa-redline.docx and CC legal@quanticafin.com. If your legal has specific clause templates, send them over and we'll produce a redline within 3 business days.
- Pen test: understood on vendor requirement and CVSS scoring. Priyom, can the Redwood compliance team sign the standard vendor report NDA and provide test endpoints?
- Retention: we'll include a matrix in the SOC2 mapping CSV that shows available retention tiers (30d/1y/7y/custom export) and the export formats.

Confirmed: follow-up sync 2027-02-11 10:00 AM PT — invite to follow from me in the next hour.

Attachments (resending):
- redwood-soc2-mapping.csv (CSV mapping: control, artifact, sample_link)
- audit-log-sample-keys.txt (example key names and export snippet)
- proposed-dpa-redline.docx (word doc with our starting redlines)

If you want a quick demo of the log export and retention UI before the meeting I can arrange a 15-minute screen share.

Cheers,
Connor

Connor / Aisha —

Received the attachments and the invite for 2/11 10:00 AM PT — I'm on that calendar. Procurement confirmed they will provide the PO template during the week of Feb 15 and legal confirmed receipt of the DPA redline. A couple of quick clarifying points from security: 

- Please ensure the pen-test scope includes any endpoints exposed by Redwood's public API that we will call; we will not require access to Redwood tenants beyond scoped test accounts.
- For audit logs, we need field-level sample (masked) examples for transaction_id, user_id, timestamp, event_type, and raw_payload. The sample file Connor attached looks OK but legal will confirm.

I'll be joined by our security engineer (cc'd procurement) on the 2/11 call. If Redwood can provide a short playbook on how you handle post-pen-test remediation timelines (SLA for fixes / patch disclosure) that would be helpful to share internally before the meeting.

Thanks,
Sara Lin
VP of Operations, Quantica Financial
sara.lin@quanticafin.com
